name: Shizu
source: Shizu is an enigma. Why is she following Shuji around? She seems awfully shy; was she his girlfriend too? Why does she constantly film him on her camera? And why doesn’t she explain herself?
translation: Shizu is an enigma. Why is she following Shuji around? She seems awfully shy; was she his girlfriend too? Why does she constantly film him on her camera? And why doesn’t she explain herself?
